issues.description: Function parameter type mismatch for build_msd_circ: the problem statement declares the parameter y_states as 'tuple[int]' (problem statement lines 116-118), while both the template implementation (template_repository/msd.py lines 93-106) and the solution implementation (solution_repository/msd.py lines 153-184) use 'y_states' annotated as list[int] in their signatures/docstrings. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected collection type for resource-state indices and lead to unnecessary type-related questions or minor mismatches when following examples or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected type for y_states consistent across materials. Preferred fix: update the problem statement signature to use 'y_states: list[int]' (or more generally 'Sequence[int]') and mention that either a list or tuple of integer qubit indices is acceptable. Alternatively, update template and solution signatures to accept 'tuple[int]' or a Sequence[int] in type hints so all three artifacts match.
